title.narrative: Enhancing Youth Civic Participation through School Mediation
Enhancing Youth Civic Participation through School Mediation

description.narrative:
The project aims to reduce school violence and enhance youth civic participation in Moldova by adapting the Finnish "Verso" peer mediation program for use in 20 selected schools in Chișinău, Bălți, Călărași, and Căușeni. The initiative responds to the rising incidents of school violence and the ineffectiveness of punitive measures, promoting a restorative approach that fosters positive behavior, empathy, and conflict resolution skills among students.
The primary Beneficiaries are 200 youth (10 per school) trained as peer mediators, 800 additional youth reached through mediation activities, 30 teachers and representatives from relevant organizations trained as trainers and 60 teachers (3 per school) trained in peer mediation techniques. Indirectly the project benefits 400 school staff, 1,000 parents, and over 4,600 students benefiting from a more peaceful school environment as well as The Ministry of Education and Research, gaining a replicable mediation model.
